glossary.definition: (1) "Dentist" means a person who is licensed under Chapter 4715. of the Revised Code to practice dentistry.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.231 - Immunity of health professionals volunteering services to school athletic program.

glossary.definition: (2) "Physician" means a person authorized under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.231 - Immunity of health professionals volunteering services to school athletic program.

glossary.definition: (3) "Registered nurse" means a nurse who is licensed as a registered nurse under Chapter 4723. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.231 - Immunity of health professionals volunteering services to school athletic program.
